description: Shared trigger-eval corpus. Each query is tagged with the ONE skill that should trigger, or 'none'. Per-skill eval files are generated from this by build_eval_sets.py, so one skill's positives become the other skills' hard negatives — which is what measures cross-talk between skills in the same domain.
